content: उपनिक्षेपः .²1 The act of depositing or placing down. .²2 An open deposit, any article given in anotherʼs charge by letting him know its form, quantity <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>Y. 2. 25</ls>; (on which <ls>Mit.</ls> says:-- उपनिक्षेपो नाम रूपसंख्याप्रदर्शनेन रक्षणार्थं परस्य हस्ते निहितं द्रव्यम्). .²3 A deposit sealed or covered up (?).
